question: I'm always enjoying reading Re: Zero. Is there any magic or something that Roswaal has modified and newly made? If there is, I'd like you to tell me the strongest spell. Please keep on doing your best with the writing!
answer: There's lots of them, but Roswaal didn't bother attaching his name, or he made up a spell to match the atmosphere of the moment and fired it off, so it's difficult. In episode seven of the anime, when it looks like he was about to fight with Beatrice, he had four colors of mana floating above his hands, and that was probably an extremely strong spell.
